summary:
NASA’s MODIS and VIIRS sensors use different technologies, producing different measurements of the same fire activity. As MODIS is gradually replaced by VIIRS, comparing wildfire data across sensors becomes increasingly challenging.

Our Solution – FIRECHRONICLE: Developed by SpaceBorne, FIRECHRONICLE is a satellite-based fire monitoring and harmonization platform that integrates MODIS and VIIRS hotspot data into a unified spatial and temporal framework. Its key innovation is making observations from different sensors more comparable, rather than simply displaying fires on a map.
details:
FIRECHRONICLE is a satellite-based wildfire monitoring and data harmonization system developed by the team "SpaceBorne". It integrates NASA's MODIS and VIIRS active fire hotspot data into an unified spatial and temporal framework.

The data is collected from four satellite sources, cleaned and standardized using Python in Google Colab, and processed through H3-based spatial analysis. Jaccard similarity, Spearman correlation, and Fire Radiative Power (FRP) comparisons are then used to evaluate agreement and differences between sensors. The results are presented through interactive maps and visualizations in the FIRECHRONICLE web application.

It provides several important benefits such as Sensor Comparability which makes MODIS and VIIRS fire datas easier to compare. Scientific Reliability that uses statistical methods to identify similarities and differences between observations. Interactive Visualization that allows users to explore wildfire activity across different geographical areas and time periods.

FIRECHRONICLE aims to improve how satellite-based wildfire information is analyzed, interpreted, and communicated.

By making observations from different satellite sensors more comparable, the platform seeks to support researchers, environmental organizations, forest managers, and emergency response authorities.

Its long-term goal is to contribute to more consistent wildfire monitoring, better-informed environmental decisions, and improved understanding of wildfire patterns worldwide, including in Türkiye.

As the SpaceBorne; through out the FIRECHRONICLE we used NASA FIRMS source of MODIS an VIIRS active data. We used Python for data cleaning processing and scientific analysis. Google Colab for cloud-based data preparation and analysis. H3 spatial index for hexagonal geographic indexing and spatial comparisons. JavaScript, TypeScript in order to web application development.

FIRECHRONICLE goes beyond conventional wildfire mapping by focusing on the scientific differences between satellite sensors.

Its creativity comes from combining multi-sensor data harmonization, statistical comparison, and interactive geographic visualization within a single platform.

Rather than simply displaying where fires have been detected, FIRECHRONICLE investigates how consistently different satellites observe fire activity.
